Name: Asters Big Furniture Pack for Alternative Textures
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[u]Description[/u]
[list]
[*]Conversion of my furniture mods to Alternative Textures[/*]
[*]All items are individually tagged to make searching with Alternative Textures easier[/*]
[*][b]Thank you to everyone who helped me get mod of the month for June ヽ(„• ᴗ •„)ﾉ[/b][/*]
[*]You can now find items in this pack easier by downloading [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13078/]Asters Catalogue[/url], which lists all the items retextured by this mod in one easy to find place﻿. Alternatively, get [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer [/url]which will show a little star icon next to any item that can be retextured.[/*]
[/list]
[u]Quick start[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract this mod and it's requirements into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]this guide[/url]﻿).[/*]
[*]It's ready to play, you will just need to buy the bucket from Robin's Carpentry shop to get started[/*]
[*]If you have trouble finding textures buy the Texture Catalogue from Robin[/*]
[/list]
Note: If you want a list of what replaces what, just look in the 'Textures' folder. Search for "png" files and it'll show you call the items. If you see anything you like the look of, right click and open containing folder to see what furniture it retextures.

[u]Compatibility[/u]
[list]
[*]This mod uses the Alternative Textures (AT) framework, which is highly compatible with other mods[/*]
[/list]
[center]Video on how to use AT in-game:
[youtube]OzCzEppsXVY[/youtube][/center]

[u]Mods to go with this one[/u]
This mod is part of my 'Big Interior' series, and is designed to work with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12002]wall and floor megapack[/url]﻿. When I play I also personally use:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11846]brullov's fire animation[/url]﻿ (I use the optional file with the transparency edit)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9984]AT tools retexture[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13078/]Asters Catalogue[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url][/*]
[/list]
[u]Credits[/u]
[list]
[*]The items tagged "by Aura" are by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108217533]AuraTheFox[/url]﻿, she has kindly given me permission to edit and publish some of her work. This includes the 'Starry Night' and painted scrolls (which are originally from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10212](CF) Aura's Japanese Furniture[/url]﻿). The futons are also based on her work.[/*]
[*]Big thanks to PeacefulEnd for making an amazing framework[/*]
[*]The ink painting on the log panels is based on a 'A Breath of Spring' by Tsou Fu-lei, dated 1360. Sourced from the Freer Gallery of Art, Smithsonian Institution[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Not a mod. This is a reference that includes all the furniture items with their tagged names. Just to make it easier to search the textures in your folder. So for example, you can search the folder for "walnut" to see all walnut coloured items I've made.
